exposure: Mother's type of diabetes (maternal diabetes mellitus vs. gestational diabetes mellitus)
cohort: The study included 49 newborns born to diabetic mothers at Yenepoya Medical College.
finding: Among 49 newborns of diabetic mothers, 8 (16.3%) were detected with congenital heart disease, with acyanotic heart disease (primarily ASD and VSD) being predominant, and neonatal heart disease more common in infants of maternal diabetes mellitus than gestational diabetes mellitus.
cross-section timing: Observations were made in newborns, implying at or shortly after birth for diagnostic purposes.
